data.exact_reserve_text: The claims development tables express the development on an underwriting year basis. At the end of the opening year, the underwriting year has not yet fully earned. One year after the opening year, the underwriting year has substantially earned, and the development of that underwriting year becomes evident. The development is only developments in actuarial assumptions.

prior_year_events.impact_description: 2018 commenced with a high degree of uncertainty including: the Ogden discount rate
unknown impact to the market of hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria (HIM); Whilst the post-HIM rate uplift was lower than anticipated, this was less relevant for Syndicate 386 classes
adverse large loss experience in the International Casualty portfolio, particularly Australia and New Zealand

named_events.loss_description: unknown impact to the market of hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria (HIM); and significant political uncertainty. Whilst the post-HIM rate uplift was lower than anticipated, this was less relevant for Syndicate 386 classes

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net release of GBP 10.854m in prior year reserves, calculated from the net claims development triangle. This was despite some adverse large loss experience in the International Casualty portfolio, particularly in Australia and New Zealand. The year commenced with uncertainties regarding the Ogden discount rate and the impact of hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria, though the latter was noted as less relevant for the syndicate's classes.
raw_causal_phrases: unknown impact to the market of hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria (HIM)
adverse large loss experience in the International Casualty portfolio, particularly Australia and New Zealand
changes in patterns of claims incidence, reporting and payment
volatility in the estimation of future costs for long tail insurance classes
incidence of catastrophic events close to the balance sheet date
changes in the legal environment, including the interpretation of liability laws and the quantum of damages
social and economic trends, for example price and wage inflation and interest rates
development is only developments in actuarial assumptions
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is net of reinsurance as no gross figure was explicitly available. Calculated from net claims development triangle.
